triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

**First touch: p2 · `domain:devx` · `pm:queue`.** Not a queue jump. `state-machine-no-initial-states` (PR #35244, #34776) should not judge update-only machines, where `initialStates` is inert; three showcase machines are refused today. Settle it before the rule reaches a release, so valid apps are not refused at publish.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

Scope note · 2026-11-18T21:53Z · from contract review delta 6992699203 on PR #35244

This card also carries a second residual. `crm_opportunity` (app-crm) declares `initialStates` listing every option of its state field. That is honest: the app records deals already won or lost, and its hook and tests create them. But a list of every option refuses nothing on insert, so the rule is satisfied by a declaration with no effect, the same class as the update-only machines. Decide here whether the rule should treat an every-option list as inert (a warning or a pass), and whether the example keeps it.
